subject.title: Per-account native command prefix for multi-agent slash commands

question: Should Slack multi-account native slash commands use explicit account-level nativeNames mapping, constrained nativePrefix sugar, or remain unsupported for duplicate native command names?
rationale: The current code has no account-level native naming contract, and prior unmerged PRs show a real design fork that adds user-visible Slack config/API surface.

options.title: Implement Validated nativeNames
options.body: Add explicit per-account native name mapping with Slack-safe format validation, duplicate/default collision checks, registration and reverse lookup support, docs, and focused tests.

options.title: Implement Constrained nativePrefix
options.body: Add prefix sugar with strict lowercase slug validation and no broad dash-stripping fallback, accepting a simpler setup at the cost of a second naming abstraction.

options.title: Document Unsupported Duplicate Names
options.body: Leave runtime unchanged and document that multiple Slack apps in one workspace must not register identical native command names.

recommendation.title: Implement Validated nativeNames
recommendation.body: Add explicit per-account native name mapping with Slack-safe format validation, duplicate/default collision checks, registration and reverse lookup support, docs, and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal on the Slack native alias and shared command-registry behavior that this decision would change.
